newsitem.title: UK: MFI says current sales up 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: MFI says current sales up 17 pct.

text.p: MFI Furniture Group Plc said on Tuesday group sales were 17 percent higher in the first 21 weeks of its current financial year.
Chairman Derek Hunt told the annual meeting sales in the UK were up by 13 percent on average trading area one percent lower than the comparable period last year.
In France sales rose 35 percent, but this was after a 25 percent increase in trading space.
Gross margins remained within the group's expectations, Hunt said.

MFI has now converted 61 of its stores to its new Homeworks format. "MFI Homeworks stores continue to perform better than the rest of the chain and we are pleased with the consumer response to them," Hunt said.
In France, six new stores have opened since the end of the financial year, making 92 outlets in total.

Hunt said the group's trade venture Howden Joinery was performing well from its 20 depots and as a result MFI plans to open a further 10 before the end of the financial year. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
